5 things we go through

What this covers

Forty-five minutes, no fluff. We go through the loan programs and structures that are moving deals in this market, what a strong pre-approval looks like, and how to keep a file from falling apart between contract and closing.

  1. 01 Where rates and buydowns actually stand, and how to explain them to a buyer without overpromising
  2. 02 Conventional, FHA, and VA side by side, and which one fits which buyer
  3. 03 What separates a pre-approval that holds up from one that does not
  4. 04 Seller concessions and temporary buydowns: when they help and when they cost your buyer money
  5. 05 The three things that most often blow up a file after contract, and how to catch them early

Come along if
